items.headline: Also on the Calendar
items.body: Also on the calendar this weekend: On Saturday, Nov. 14, Revolution Fencing Center hosts Y10, Y12 and Y14 Mixed in West Chester, Pa., with no Elite FC entries yet; preregistration closes that day. On Sunday, Nov. 15, Wanglei Fencing’s November Cup II (Cadet and Junior, in Plainsboro Township, N.J.) still has nobody from Elite signed up; it is good practice with a decently competitive field, a fit for older fencers. Preregistration closes Saturday, Nov. 14.
